purpose: Own history-preserving Service Request relationships to LLD-02 Customer Organization and Contact identities without turning Advanced Search labels into relational identity or creating a competing Current Handler authority.

tables.name: sr_customer_relationships
columns: sr_customer_relationship_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY
service_request_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES service_requests(service_request_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
customer_org_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES customer_organizations(customer_org_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
relationship_state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(relationship_state IN ('active','superseded'))
origin_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(origin_kind IN ('manual_review','advanced_search_review','correction'))
reconciliation_proposal_id TEXT CHECK(reconciliation_proposal_id IS NULL OR length(reconciliation_proposal_id)>0)
opened_at_utc INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(opened_at_utc>=0)
closed_at_utc INTEGER
opened_command_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES command_receipts(command_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
closed_command_id TEXT REFERENCES command_receipts(command_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
reason_category TEXT
CHECK((relationship_state='active' AND closed_at_utc IS NULL AND closed_command_id IS NULL) OR (relationship_state='superseded' AND closed_at_utc IS NOT NULL AND closed_command_id IS NOT NULL))
CHECK(origin_kind<>'advanced_search_review' OR reconciliation_proposal_id IS NOT NULL)
rules: at most one active canonical Customer Organization relationship exists per Service Request
Customer labels/account codes are proposal evidence only; accepted relationship always targets immutable LLD-02 customer_org_id
changing Customer supersedes the prior row and inserts a new row atomically; history is never overwritten
Customer change invokes the LLD-06 ServiceRequestCustomerClassificationParticipant in the same UnitOfWork so incompatible current classification is invalidated rather than silently remapped
unresolved or ambiguous source Customer evidence leaves the current relationship unchanged and does not block independent SR source facts
reconciliation_proposal_id is an immutable opaque LLD-04 evidence identity validated through the reconciliation provider rather than a physical cross-packet FK

tables.name: sr_contact_relationships
columns: sr_contact_relationship_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY
service_request_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES service_requests(service_request_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
reference_role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(reference_role IN ('customer_contact','current_handler_reference'))
contact_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES contacts(contact_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
customer_org_context_id TEXT REFERENCES customer_organizations(customer_org_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
relationship_state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(relationship_state IN ('active','superseded'))
origin_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(origin_kind IN ('manual_review','advanced_search_review','correction'))
reconciliation_proposal_id TEXT CHECK(reconciliation_proposal_id IS NULL OR length(reconciliation_proposal_id)>0)
supporting_sr_source_field_observation_id TEXT REFERENCES sr_source_field_observations(sr_source_field_observation_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
opened_at_utc INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(opened_at_utc>=0)
closed_at_utc INTEGER
opened_command_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES command_receipts(command_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
closed_command_id TEXT REFERENCES command_receipts(command_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
reason_category TEXT
CHECK((relationship_state='active' AND closed_at_utc IS NULL AND closed_command_id IS NULL) OR (relationship_state='superseded' AND closed_at_utc IS NOT NULL AND closed_command_id IS NOT NULL))
CHECK(origin_kind<>'advanced_search_review' OR reconciliation_proposal_id IS NOT NULL)
CHECK(reference_role<>'current_handler_reference' OR supporting_sr_source_field_observation_id IS NOT NULL)
rules: at most one active relationship exists per Service Request and reference_role
Contact identity and affiliation remain LLD-02 authority; this table only records ticket relationship/context
customer_org_context_id captures organization-at-use when the relationship opens and is immutable history even if Contact affiliation or SR Customer later changes
a Contact affiliation mismatch is reviewed explicitly and never silently reassigns/merges the Contact
customer_contact may be linked manually or through reviewed source reconciliation; source Customer Contact text remains separate accepted source evidence
current_handler_reference is only an identity resolution of the source-owned Current Handler fact; it never supplies a local handler string or overrides the current source projection

a current_handler_reference is effective for current-handler display only while supporting_sr_source_field_observation_id equals sr_current_source_projection.current_handler_observation_id; when source handler changes or clears, the old relationship remains history but is not current handler authority
static LLD-03 guards verify supporting observation belongs to the same SR and uses field_key customer_contact_label or current_handler_label matching reference_role
reconciliation_proposal_id is an immutable opaque LLD-04 evidence identity validated through the reconciliation provider rather than a physical cross-packet FK

indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_sr_customer_active ON sr_customer_relationships(service_request_id) WHERE relationship_state='active'
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_sr_contact_active_role ON sr_contact_relationships(service_request_id,reference_role) WHERE relationship_state='active'
database_guards: BEFORE UPDATE permits only governed active-to-superseded closure fields; superseded rows reject further UPDATE
BEFORE DELETE always raises append-only relationship-history protection
BEFORE INSERT current_handler_reference validates supporting LLD-03 source observation belongs to the same SR and field_key='current_handler_label'
BEFORE INSERT advanced_search_review customer_contact validates optional supporting LLD-03 source observation, when supplied, belongs to the same SR and field_key='customer_contact_label'

for origin_kind='advanced_search_review' the authoritative LLD-03 service validates reconciliation_proposal_id through the LLD-04 provider inside the same UnitOfWork: Customer rows require the exact pending proposal_kind='sr_customer_reconciliation', customer_contact rows require 'sr_contact_reconciliation', and current_handler_reference rows require 'sr_current_handler_reconciliation' for the same Service Request context, all bound to the current outer AcceptReconciliationProposal command; LLD-04 transitions that same proposal to accepted later in the same UnitOfWork after owner/participant writes, and any failure rolls both sides back
no LLD-03 trigger or FK reaches into LLD-04 private tables
all relationship acceptance revalidates LLD-02 target lifecycle/current affiliation and LLD-03 SR revision/current reference state inside the writer UnitOfWork

reference freshness token binds SR revision, active Customer/contact relationship IDs, target Contact revision and current affiliation relationship identity/revision, target Customer revision, and exact supporting source observation when applicable
migration_dependency: LLD-03 sequence 3 creates this schema without physical dependency on LLD-04 tables. LLD-04 immutable proposal identities are opaque cross-packet evidence references validated through the owned provider at runtime, eliminating the former sequence-3/sequence-4 migration cycle without changing reconciliation authority or provenance.
ownership: LLD-02 owns Customer/Contact identities and affiliation; LLD-03 owns SR-to-reference relationship history; LLD-04 owns immutable import evidence/proposals; LLD-06 owns classification consequences. No packet may bypass these interfaces by writing another owner's tables directly.
